name: dsh-cursor-layout
description: Cursor/VSCode-style DSH workbench layout: the right-hand workbench column (Monaco editor, file tree, browser, terminal, diff review) is the wide middle pane and the AI conversation a fixed-width right column, with a header pill + shortcut (⌘⌥M) to flip back to the native Agent view (centred conversation, workbench hidden). A Cursor-style changed-files bar above the composer lists the files this conversation changed with Undo / Keep / Review and matches the composer width; clicking one of its file rows or Review projects a visible target first (agent view: media opens the right-hand peek preview, text switches back to the IDE view with the diff focused; binary records open the file itself) instead of opening in the hidden workbench column. In the Agent view, clicking a video/image link opens the VSCode editor preview docked on the RIGHT instead of switching to the IDE view. Clicking the native changed-files card (data-changed-files) switches to the IDE view first so its review tab lands in the visible workbench instead of the hidden column. Clicking a delivered-file card (data-presented-file) opens that file in the IDE view's editor tab - code, images and videos alike - instead of an official sidebar tab in the hidden workbench, and the editor's left rail switches to its file tree so the file's location is expanded and highlighted. A session with no open editor files falls back to the Agent view, and closing the last file tab switches back to it automatically.
